title: Instructional Curriculum Materials, Supplies, and Digital Resources

onscreen_lines.desc: 2.2.1 MARKET BASKET 1 - General Curriculum & Instructional Materials, including materials that facilitate and support the planning and delivery of quality standards-based instruction and/or extend content knowledge or expertise for students, such as: A. Reading materials, including the supporting digital and electronic component, audiobooks, electronic, and paper materials B. Content-oriented materials C. Program kits, resource materials, and consumables D. Manipulatives E. Specialized programming materials F. Graphing Calculators G. Assessments H. Digital/Online Collections & Media Libraries I. Digital/Online Coursework & Tutorials J. Digital/Online Simulations / Explorations/ Problem Solving
onscreen_lines.note: Please include the general discount off for all catalog items in this market basket, if applicable. A response of "0" is acceptable if vendor's published catalog is already reflective of all discounts. If vendor does not offer a general discount for catalog items, please select the "NO BID" option. Note: Failure to respond to at least one of the proposed discount structures under the "Line Items" tab shall constitute a non-responsive bid. Alternatively vendor may attach a price list on the "Response Attachments" tab, if needed. Supplemental catalogs and/or price structure documentation should be scanned and uploaded to the “Response Attachments” tab. A published link to catalogs and/or pricing for goods that may be provided. Links to catalog pricing must be kept current during the term of the awarded agreement. It is the intent of HISD to award a manufacturer’s complete line of products, when possible.

onscreen_lines.desc: 2.2.4 MARKET BASKET 4 - Special Populations Materials including materials and equipment with the primary purpose of supporting activities specific to instruction and compliance requirements under state and federal laws; and expanding, maintaining, or innovating inclusive education to meet to meet individual student needs with tiered, scaffolded, specialized and extensive supports(e.g., special education, gifted and talented, dual language, Advanced Placement and International Baccalaureate). A. Specialized programming materials and equipment B. Instructional support materials C. Intervention materials/devices D. Acceleration Materials E. Enrichment Materials Special Education Materials & Supplies, including but not limited to the following: 1. Special Education Adaptive Equipment 2. Hearing Aids 3. Hearing Aid Batteries 4. Cochlear Implant Batteries 5. Rechargeable Batteries 6. FM Units/DM Units (Transmitters, Receivers, Boots/Shoes, etc.) 7. Troubleshooting and repair of units and technology 8. Tools to repair hearing aids and cochlear implants 9. Dri-Aid Packs 10. Cleaning materials and kits for hearing aids and cochlear implants 11. Ear Molds 12. Tubing/Filters 13. Hearing aid and cochlear implant cases

onscreen_lines.desc: 2.2.5 MARKET BASKET 5 - Montessori Materials, including didactic activities for students to learn through exploration and discovery with hands-on, 3-dimensional work. Numerous shelves and child-sized furniture are required to display these materials in various areas of the classroom to address sensorial, practical life, math, language, science, geography, and social studies learning. This encourages the child to build independence, order, coordination, and concentration in accord with the Montessori Philosophy of Education, creating lifelong, independent learners by individualizing instruction. A. Specialized programming materials and equipment B. Instructional support materials C. Intervention materials/devices D. Acceleration materials E. Enrichment materials F. Specialized furniture, including shelving, tables, and chairs

onscreen_lines.desc: 2.2.6 MARKET BASKET 6 - Digital Tools, including but not limited to materials and tools that facilitate and support student engagement or promote students’ ability to author digital content: A. Utilities /digital tools B. Digital authoring suites C. Collaboration / Conferencing D. Software for equipment E. Gamification F. Digital portfolios G. Multimedia production All market baskets can include Curriculum and Materials (including digital, electronic, and paper materials) listed below, but are not limited to these items. Books which include but are not limited to the following: 1. Paperback books 2. eBooks 3. Digital textbook platforms 4. Audiobooks 5. Hard-bound and spiral-bound books 6. Reference books 7. Trade and non-trade books 8. Professional books 9. Workbooks/study guides/consumables/work texts 10. Instructional/educational books 11. Leveled readers 12. Braille, large print, and audio books 13. Planners and agendas Periodicals which include but are not limited to the following: 1. Subscriptions- (not online subscriptions) 2. Magazines 3. Journals 4. Newspapers New & Used Textbooks, which include but are not limited to the following: 1. Non-state adopted books 2. Post-secondary books (AP/IB, Dual Credit)
